description: Returns the trust answer for one UUAID (GET /trust/{uuaid}): credentialed (true/false), state (credentialed, key-proven or unverified), the reasons, as_of, how the key is bound, and each credential with verified, stale and its reason. Use it before relying on another agent. credentialed is false unless the API's summary is fully consistent. An unknown, removed, blocked or hidden UUAID returns {code: "not_found", fix}. Read-only.
name: get_trust
